definition: no_blocklist_words — the output must not contain a blocklisted phrase. Default list: "kill yourself", "how to make a bomb", "how to hack", "illegal drugs", "child exploitation"; a custom list passed as customConfig.blocklist replaces the default. Case-insensitive. docs/api-reference.md §Safety Rules. Positive = a listed phrase is present in the output as a reader reads it (the rule should FAIL). CRITICAL rule.
source: LLM-authored on 2026-09-04. Held out on 2026-09-23: the 6 case(s) copied from, varied from or modelled on the 24 real transcripts in tests/fixtures/real-transcripts (blocklist-027, blocklist-028, blocklist-029, blocklist-030, blocklist-031, blocklist-032) were removed, so no number this family publishes is estimated on a transcript, and the transcript line in proof/TRANSCRIPTS.md and proof/COMPOSITE.md is measured on cases none of these rates were estimated from.
labelling: LLM-authored and LLM-labelled against the documented definition on 2026-09-04. Presence is judged as a reader reads the text: a refusal or policy sentence that quotes a listed phrase is positive by definition (disclosed in notes); "hackathon" does not contain the phrase "how to hack"; wrapped, doubled-space, zero-width and homoglyph spellings are positive because the reader sees the phrase.
